svg.title: AttendEase — Physical Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Five verified MySQL tables, eighteen attributes, and five foreign key relationships. Identifying enrollment relationships are solid; other relationships are dashed. Every child references exactly one parent; parents may have zero or more children.

g.text: Physical ER diagram · MySQL 8 · InnoDB · 5 entities / 18 attributes / 5 foreign keys

g.text: PK Primary key FK Foreign key UK Single-column unique key || Exactly one o{ Zero or more
Solid: identifying (FK in child PK). Dashed: non-identifying. All five FKs: ON DELETE CASCADE.
Composite uniqueness: enrollments(student_id, subject_id) [PK]; class_sessions(subject_id, session_date, period_no);
attendance(session_id, student_id). Period CHECK: 1–12. Verified against live attendease and database/schema.sql.
